paper_title: Hole Mobility Modulation in Single-Crystal Metal Phthalocyanines by Changing the Metal- $\nabla \cdot \pi - \pi$ Interactions

knowledge_points.content: A series of planar metal phthalocyanines (MPcs) including CuPc, CoPc, ZnPc, FePc, NiPc, and MnPc, along with metal-free phthalocyanine ($H_2Pc$), were synthesized as single crystals to study the effect of central metal coordination on electronic properties.
knowledge_points.evidence: Single crystals of $H_2Pc$, CuPc, CoPc, ZnPc, FePc, NiPc, and MnPc were grown using physical vapor transport method.

knowledge_points.content: The hole mobility of phthalocyanine single-crystal field-effect transistors follows the order: $ZnPc > MnPc > FePc > CoPc > CuPc > H_2Pc > NiPc$.
knowledge_points.evidence: Single-crystal field-effect transistors were made and showed a hole mobility order of $ZnPc > MnPc > FePc > CoPc > CuPc > H_2Pc > NiPc$.

knowledge_points.content: All studied metal-free and metal phthalocyanine single crystals exhibit hole transport properties with mobilities exceeding 0.1 $cm^2 V^{-1} s^{-1}$.
knowledge_points.evidence: The results show that both $H_2Pc$ and MPcs are hole transport properties and the mobilities of both $H_2Pc$ and MPcs are greater than 0.1 $cm^2 V^{-1} s^{-1}$.

knowledge_points.content: The intermolecular distance ($d_{spacing}$) in phthalocyanine crystals is modulated by the central metal atom, with MnPc showing the minimum distance of 3.1731 Å and NiPc showing the maximum distance of 3.2970 Å.
knowledge_points.evidence: Thereinto, the maximum $d_{spacing}$ is equal to 3.2970 Å in NiPc while the minimum $d_{spacing}$ is 3.1731 Å in MnPc.

knowledge_points.content: Hole mobility in metal phthalocyanines increases as the intermolecular distance between parallel planes along the shortest packing axis (b-axis) decreases.
knowledge_points.evidence: Furthermore, with decreasing of the intermolecular distance of MPcs, the hole mobilities of MPcs are increased gradually with decreasing intermolecular distances

knowledge_points.content: In MnPc and CoPc, the presence of a singly occupied $d_{z^2}$ orbital close to the ligand HOMO facilitates stronger $M \cdots \pi(N)$ interactions, which reduces intermolecular distances and enhances charge transfer integrals.
knowledge_points.evidence: Stronger interactions in both MnPc and CoPc for $M \cdots \pi(N)$ type of interaction can be linked to their ground state metal atom d-electron configuration with singly occupied $d_{z^2}$ orbital close to their $a_{1u}$ ligand HOMO.

knowledge_points.content: The preferred crystal growth direction and the primary charge transport direction in phthalocyanine micro-ribbon single crystals is the [010] direction, which corresponds to the shortest crystallographic b-axis.
knowledge_points.evidence: The corresponding SAEDs reveal that the preferable crystal growth directions of $H_2Pc$ and MPcs are [010], which is precisely the shortest axis (b axis) of the single crystals.

knowledge_points.content: Phthalocyanine single crystals ($H_2Pc$ and MPcs) belong to the $P2_1/n$ space group and maintain structural stability without phase transitions between 100 K and room temperature.
knowledge_points.evidence: The seven crystals ($H_2Pc$, CuPc, CoPc, ZnPc, FePc, NiPc, and MnPc) are of $P2_1/n$ space groups... These results suggest there is no phase transition from low temperature to room temperature for all studied $H_2Pc$ and MPcs systems.

knowledge_points.content: Density functional theory (DFT) calculations combined with a 1D polaron transport model qualitatively reproduce the experimental trend of hole mobility in MPcs, identifying the hole transfer integral ($t_h$) as a dominant factor.
knowledge_points.evidence: Density functional theory (DFT) and 1D polaron transport theory reach a good agreement in reproducing the experimentally measured trend for hole mobility... the role of intermolecular distance becomes critically dependent on the central atoms.

knowledge_points.content: Analysis of the Reduced Density Gradient (RDG) and Bond Critical Points (BCP) indicates that MnPc and ZnPc possess the strongest attractive intermolecular interactions among the studied phthalocyanines.
knowledge_points.evidence: Generally, the interactions energies from BCPs follow the order of $MnPc > ZnPc > CoPc > CuPc > FePc > NiPc > H_2Pc$. ZnPc and MnPc exhibit strongest attractive intermolecular interactions compared to the other.

knowledge_points.content: Single-crystal field-effect transistors were fabricated using a top-contact configuration with gold electrodes on octadecyltrichlorosilane (OTS)-modified $SiO_2/Si$ substrates.
knowledge_points.evidence: Micro-ribbons single crystals were in situ grown on the octadecyltrichlorosilane (OTS)-modified $SiO_2/Si$ substrate. Then gold electrodes were thermally evaporated on the top surface of single crystals using the copper grid as the mask.

knowledge_points.content: The central metal atoms in MPcs have a notable impact on hole transfer integrals but a relatively minor impact on hole-vibrational coupling (Huang-Rhys factors), as the molecular geometry remains largely planar across the series.
knowledge_points.evidence: the role of the central metal atoms may be twofold. In one way, they have a stronger impact towards hole transfer integrals... On the other hand, they can also affect the hole-vibrational coupling... However, metal atoms exhibit less impact towards hole-vibrational coupling.
